notes.title: Fan Art Contest for Dimensional Gates
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/222ce23cb794bb7133ae1528d07f181323365e09.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Dimensional Gates is having a Fan Art Contest!![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios is having a fan art contest for any artwork that has to do with Dimensional Gates or Laurel's Day. The winners will have their artwork displayed in a special area in the PC on the airship, and will win the sequence needed to unlock the developer backdoor to the airship at the beginning of the game in Doller's House. 

This artwork can be anything from the game; characters, scenes, towns, and NPCs. 

All artwork should be submitted via email to [u]NotAllowedtoDieGamingStudio@yahoo.com[/u] to enter. [b][i]Contest ends December 31st, 2025.[/i][/b]
[/p][p][b]Specifications for artwork:[/b] [/p][p]All artwork must be able to be loaded using Windows and able to edit sizing to fit the game if needed. PNG and JPEG preferred. All forms of 2D art are accepted. 

[b]Winners:[/b][/p][p]Winners will be announced on Jan 31st, 2026 on Steam and their name will be included in the game's credits as well. The name of the artist will also be attached with their work on the PC inside the game. [/p][p]
[b]Rules:[/b][/p][p][i]Anyone can enter, but Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios highly recommends playing the demo or Laurel's Day first.[/i][/p][p][i]All artwork must be from the game Dimensional Gates, or Laurel's Day to be considered for this contest. [/i][/p][p][i]Any artwork entered into the contest must have the artist's direct permission to be entered and allowed to be used in the game. Any artwork entered into the contest will be giving the right to Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios to modify artwork for gaming purposes.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p]Legal Information:[/p][p][i]Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios reserves the right to use said artwork or remove it after the fact. Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios also reserves the right to showcase the artwork inside of Dimensional Gates and any entered work is the artists permission to do so.[/i] [/p]

notes.title: Laurel's Day Full Game Release September 19th
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/8a758e6c73b6aff251b196102326a91cc7089f7e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Laurel's Day became too powerful to just be a side game inside of Dimensional Gates alone. What is happening is we are releasing Laurel's Day September 19th alongside the Dimensional Gates Demo as a full game release. Being inexpensive and at a 40% discount for two weeks from launch date, Laurel's Day is a great way for you to get more information on how Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios makes games. The Dimensional Gate Demo doesn't tie things up and end a game, but Laurel's Day will allow you to see how powerful the endings Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios makes.   [/p][p][/p][p]I will also be including Laurel's Day inside of the Dimensional Gates Collector's Edition as well...[/p]

notes.content:
[p][b]Unique Locations in Dimensional Gates[/b]

[b]Thena – Fantasy world full of magic and normal RPG fantasy tropes. This is the ONLY dimension that has supplies for the Mage. (Doller’s Dimension)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/8ea30d2b34ea8e8eb9a279ffdaf536df81dd4773.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/1b02e8a852457756295210aa4f28e814465cb3c7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/a9a5289d232b2fbb538582c8b601f5cbd80a1140.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Towns:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Fayne – [i]Doller’s home town (Demo)[/i][/p][p]Gleyn[/p][p]Shena[/p][p]Kernon[/p][p]Ramport[/p][p]Kaylen[/p][p]Zarna – [i]Winter town[/i][/p][p]Poshi[/p][p]Nidel[/p][p]Schal[/p][p]Yalon[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Dungeons:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Tomb [i](Demo)[/i][/p][p]Forest of Fayne [i](Demo)[/i][/p][p]Temple of Tyronin[/p][p]Hayden Cemetary[/p][p]Kernon Forest Cave[/p][p]Frozen Mine[/p][p]Dimensional Crystal Temple[/p][p]Poshi Cemetary[/p][p]Abandoned Cave[/p][p]Fairy Woods[/p][p]Island Forest[/p][p]Crystal Mine[/p][p]Lich’s Lair[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Other Locations:[/b]
[/p][p]Gate Cave[/p][p]Hayden Castle[/p][p]Boat House[/p][p]Gaming House – [i]Each dimension has a Gaming House that you have a chance to win a special weapon or armor.[/i][/p][p]Thief’s Hideout[/p][p]Book Vender’s Tent – [i]Each dimension has a Book Vender’s Tent and you can buy a book for each character to learn a new skill.[/i][/p][p]Igloo[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Kanlin – Sci-fi dimension that uses guns and other science. Without magic, the residents of this dimension are having trouble fighting off the magical creatures that keep leaking into their dimension to destroy them. Shadow Squad dimension.[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/4c995b9d95cf6827a8e49c3548455d500a3f83f6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/00714c339a0fc41ce0becb5b49442ba2afdb59ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/10e0fb3c9c8ea30f541f3052d27c4b5207381ab9.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]  [/p][p]
[b]Towns:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Jarvek [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Yargn [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Basch [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Delvin[/p][p]Hanin[/p][p]Brogu[/p][p]Palneta[/p][p]Kynn’s Resort[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Dungeons:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Shadow Squad Cave [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Volcano [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Graveyard[/p][p]Haunted Mansion[/p][p]Mystic’s Bunker[/p][p]Abandoned Cave[/p][p]Mountains[/p][p]Shetman Research Center[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Other Locations:[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Temple [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Worker’s Tent [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Book Vender’s Tent [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]City of Ughan[/p][p]Military Base[/p][p]House[/p][p]Dimensional Crystal Temple[/p][p]Igloo[/p][p]Groto[/p][p]Gaming House[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[b]Jamonic – Nomadic like dimension that is being controlled by an evil Earth Corporation that is using the natives as slaves to mine their own resources for Earth to take. Yeign’s dimension.[/b]
[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/bdb47118f2895d6c1b928cd33711550cd289e4c8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/324b73f6eb78d0ce3bdcc1b83b4865c5c15a5e63.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/dd4092d76705517e29ad6cfd30fbfb2a1a33af15.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]  [/p][p]
[b]Towns:[/b]

Navon [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Portea[/p][p]Jairl[/p][p]Cloverfield[/p][p]Franklin[/p][p]Portland[/p][p]Springfield[/p][p]Ponav[/p][p]Shetman Pharmaceutical Farm[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Dungeons:[/b]

Navon Mines [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Shetman Tower[/p][p]Ancient Navish Pyramid[/p][p]Shetman Desert Mine[/p][p]Abandoned Mine[/p][p]Shetman Research Center[/p][p]Shetman Cemetery[/p][p]Ice Gate Mine[/p][p]Dimensional Crystal Castle[/p][p]Gate Cave[/p][p]Cave to Cerabum[/p][p]Redleaf Forest[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Other Locations:[/b]

Hunting Grounds [i](demo)[/i][/p][p]Seaside Fort[/p][p]House[/p][p]Ancient Navish Castle – Learn the secrets the Navish clan lost[/p][p]Shetman Beach House[/p][p]Nanov General’s Tent[/p][p]Book Vender’s Tent[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Cerabum – Dimension based off the concept of Hell itself, Freia calls this place home even if she feels like an outsider. Can she finally become a Grand Demon?[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/dcdaa3af19b6629f037791afd0f9172ba5e14acc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/490f198024067820777c463f7673e8547e556bfe.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/af8417b143c5e82daf7236f13a08609b25983b4b.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Dungeons:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Dimensional Crystal Cave[/p][p]Despondency Caverns – Dominca’s Lair[/p][p]Putrefied Castle – Putroin’s Lair[/p][p]Disdain Forest – Jagyon’s Lair[/p][p]Deepfall Ravine – Asonga’s Lair[/p][p]Despairing Confinement – Aborin’s Prison[/p][p]Deceptive Hollow – Gargonal’s Lair[/p][p]Ghastly Swamp Crypt – Sakuri’s Tomb[/p][p]Deadly Echoes Forest – Nasangi’s Lair[/p][p]Mount Despair – Harborym’s Lair[/p][p]Lava Chambers[/p][p]Dark Catacombs – Mystic’s Lair[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Other Locations:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Insidious Manor – Moria’s Palace[/p][p]Syrine’s Mirage – Syrine’s Lair[/p][p]Gaming House[/p][p]Book Vender’s Tent[/p][p]Cerabum’s Surface – Planet’s surface[/p][p]Mortlyn – Demon cave town without shops[/p][p]Angel’s Respite – Fallen angel’s retreat[/p][p]Assassin’s Cave[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Rahmur – Hidden even from the knowledge of Dr. Masio, Rahmur is based on the concept of heaven, and even holds a larger secret that the Commander never expected. Learn the whole true storyline by unlocking the secrets Rahmur holds.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/19b3a28dcb62d216a6934fd5cd817a09ab9f7c4b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Temples:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Sky Temple – Harlen and Farlen’s Temple[/p][p]Temple of Light[/p][p]Temple of Enlightenment[/p][p]Temple of Enrichment[/p][p]Temple of Empowerment[/p][p]Temple of Consciousness – Goddess’ and Consciousness’ Temple[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Other Locations:[/b][/p][p]Prominence – Fairy Village[/p][p]Haught – Rahmur’s surface[/p][p]Dimensional Gate Cave to Cerabum[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Earth – The year is 2386 and everyone on Earth is on edge because of the Shetman Corporation’s sudden growth to power. Using resources no one has any idea where the Shetman Corporation could possibly be getting them, no one else on Earth has any idea they are using other dimensions to collect said resources.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/5316b6cb86ecfc591ce8bb331f481cb22ee40a0b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Locations:[/b][/p][p]Underground Shetman Research Lab[/p][p]Grand Shetman Vista Mall[/p][p]Shetman Corporate Offices[/p][p]Shetman Corporate Jail[/p][p]Jane’s Office[/p][p]CEO’s Office

[/p][p]
[b]Other Video Games Locations: There are several other video games that are fully playable on the PC in the airship cabin. Each of these games runs off its own personal save, item, and random battle generators to make sure they are not a part of the main game, but still fully playable, able to save, and have its own inventory without messing with the main game. If you die in one of these games, it’s takes you to the main title of them and doesn’t end the main game at all. Because of this, I have actually for the first time created a separate OS inside of an OS. This causes the PC in the game to feel real and immersive.[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/bd1e03e329f81fe1509954aec3fdf7247b053a69.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Laurel’s Day: Follow Laurel through a day in school that even she knows isn’t going to end well. Become Katja, Laurel’s confidence and imagination, as she fights her way through the toughest parts of Laurel’s day in order to get her locket back her father got for her. Find out the truth behind her imagination and what really happened. [/b][i](Laurel's Day has become a very powerful game, even if inside of Dimensional Gates and technically a side game. Because of this, there is a chance it will become a standalone game as well that I will sell on Steam too, and will be free inside of Dimensional Gates as well. In talks with Steam and hoping they will allow me to include all of the games inside of Dimensional Gates to be in the Collector's Edition of Dimensional Gates as standalone games.)[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/8a758e6c73b6aff251b196102326a91cc7089f7e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Locations:[/b][/p][p]Laurel’s Home[/p][p]Path to School[/p][p]School Hallway[/p][p]Classroom[/p][p]Girl’s Bathroom[/p][p]Nurse’s Office[/p][p]Cafeteria[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Imminent Distress: Stranded on an unknown planet, you must search and seek out the materials your crew needs to make a distress signal needed to get you all back home. Do you have what it takes to make it off a planet full of imminent danger? Basic survivor game using RPG Maker MV engine.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/a4cf157cb20589f4cd1e52021a83c51e7ed92d63.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Locations:[/b][/p][p]Space Ship Inside[/p][p]Planet Surface[/p]

notes.title: Imminent Distress is Started
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/a4cf157cb20589f4cd1e52021a83c51e7ed92d63.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Losing an arrogant Captain on a strange planet, the crew warned him he was the only one that could fly the ship. Now stranded and with no way to leave, can you find the materials needed to make the distress signal to get you all back home? [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/d6581e1ac341c0a876a4704016560b7f8b211224.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Use your character to explore this strange new world, but be careful because there are many ways to die. Forced to find materials, you have to create better tools to get the crystals your crew needs in order to make the radio antennae. Can you survive the world's surface and many caves it has laid out before you?[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Laurel's Day Started
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/255eb9e1110dd4d19b69085115490a9526aabcc8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Follow Laurel, a teenage girl from Earth in modern times, go to school and deal with the day that lies ahead of her. Can you make it through the day without running out of energy? Can you get her locket that her dad got for her back from the evil henchmen and unravel the secret Laurel holds deep inside? [/p][p][/p][p][b]Beat Laurel's Day and unlock Laurel's Locket in the Dimensional Gate's vending machine that allows the wearer special protection.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]  [/p][p][b]Laurel:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/f551fe5c2900e16ac4c7a5d45fbf54e68a68781f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This is just one of the RPGs that will be included with Dimensional Gates and fully playable on the PC in the airship cabin. Laurel's Day is not your normal RPG storyline and will tear at your heart a lot, but is a powerful storyline that we can all learn from. [/p]

notes.title: Meet the Game's Concepts
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/6426adf10f0225f531d5e11175d0d640ad3c5067.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Normal Mode vs Story Mode – [/b]Normal mode has random encounters, hard boss fights, and the ability to open up the entire expansion to the storyline. Story mode there are no random encounters, no shopping, no side jobs, you cannot open the menu and instead only save, can save wherever, and the expansion to the storyline that unlocks Cerabum and Rahmur are not available.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/bdb47118f2895d6c1b928cd33711550cd289e4c8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/1b02e8a852457756295210aa4f28e814465cb3c7.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Night and day cycles –[/b] Night and day can change how a town feels and what is open or closed. Shops being closed, and ready for robbing them, the Bars are open at night as well as the always open Inn. Dimensional Gates makes sure there are things to do at night in towns, like robbing stores and finding shady characters to sell you exclusive items or send you on side jobs.  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/00714c339a0fc41ce0becb5b49442ba2afdb59ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/490f198024067820777c463f7673e8547e556bfe.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/4c995b9d95cf6827a8e49c3548455d500a3f83f6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/e0c0cf7bbee36a0ac9f0c8bf0da3066809c49008.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Unique Environment for each dimension - [/b]Each dimension has several biomes and unique environments as well making them each feel like you traveled to another world. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/c821c75c5bcc82c8a8ff0a039d030b3d35a20af4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Robbing stores[/b] – Once you get Yosei, as a thief, he can rob any store with an open window at night, unless you unlock his final class. Walking up and just opening a chest isn’t that exciting though, so sometimes you are attacked by the owner of the shop. In these fights, only Yosei is there to fight back forcing you to earn that stolen prize.  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/a7fab26d2806791ab8bb7eeabee37eef3548342c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/bd1e03e329f81fe1509954aec3fdf7247b053a69.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][b]Working PC on Airship –[/b] Not just fully working, but boots itself up every time you turn it on. With loading screens and beeps at the right time, the PC feels like it really is working. On the PC you have the options to:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]Read short stories –[/b] Short stories you can read about the characters in the game and more. All written by the Dev David Listzwan, they can help to unravel some of the mysterious side jobs hidden in the game.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Watch movies and shows –[/b] RPG themed movie and show parodies to help make the world around you feel alive, and to give you a laugh or two.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]News Reels –[/b] Media directly from Earth that has no idea about these dimensions. Only the Shetman Corporation knows and is using these dimensions for personal gain. In these news reels, the anchor will go through the stages of the Shetman Corporation rising to power rapidly.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Play video games –[/b] Inside of Dimensional Gates video game, are other video games. Not small ones either. There are two other RPG’s that when you beat them, they unlock powerful accessories for the main game. One being another direct RPG like Dimensional Gates, and the other in the style of having the monsters block your path and you have to fight them to move forward. No random encounters in that one.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]System Folder –[/b] Another fun feature to the game, there are Vending Machines on the Airship that you can upgrade. In the System Folder you can do just that. Finding different discs spread out all over the dimensions, you can unlock powerful Shetman quality accessories and items.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/8ea30d2b34ea8e8eb9a279ffdaf536df81dd4773.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/dcdaa3af19b6629f037791afd0f9172ba5e14acc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/324b73f6eb78d0ce3bdcc1b83b4865c5c15a5e63.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Side Jobs –[/b] Obviously extra things you can do in the game to earn rewards; side jobs are also something you need to do the right way. If you do something wrong, or too soon even, it can have dire results you will have to live with. Make sure to do all of your side jobs before moving forward, and do them right, or pay the consequences. Completing Side Jobs can lead to rewards of special reusable items, and even keys needed to unlock the secret at Poshi Cemetery.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/dd4092d76705517e29ad6cfd30fbfb2a1a33af15.png"][/img][/p][p][b]NPC’s Working and Playing –[/b] For immersion purposes, towns have citizens doing their jobs, playing, and just relaxing and having a good time. Intricate details in their chores that go beyond other RPGs dedication to level of detail.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/6285d46c789b0dee14fc933cb45740cca6101173.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Image Changes –[/b] As you change the armor on each character, their image will change according to that armor to add more immersion. Images only change on character and not text boxes. [/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Class Leveling Up –[/b] Each time you level up a character’s class, they level up their Max stats as well. Doller levels up her Intelligence and Wisdom, while Yeign his Attack and Defense. Magic also evolves to become more powerful and better control as each magic user levels up their class. There is no long list of spells that grows, instead they evolve and grow as their user does.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/47c7da6a59f12755e61c89cc43d25d5b51eec727.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Instant Dimensional Travel –[/b] Like you’ve seen in the trailer, you can travel to and from each dimension with the press of a button using the airship. However, you will have to find and bring back the dimensional crystals from Jamonic, Cerabum, and Rahmur to be able to travel to them with the airship. These dimensions can be traveled to using dimensional gates until then, but only if you unlock the airship in the connecting dimension.  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/82934c95ea4e24931b1e365a3cb2807859e901f7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Shadow Squad –[/b] Not just the saviors of Doller, the Shadow Squad are in fact your airship crew. Being a part of the story and stealing the airship for the Dimensional Travelers, the Shadow Squad will instill pride in your airship crew more than any other game has. The Commander guides them, but Symon and Syrah are the heart and soul of the Shadow Squad. [/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/632f8352aa172bb94b8d0b641ae86b19a6ece461.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Fighting the Dimensional Beast –[/b] Which dimension you fight the beast in is up to you. Once you are able to bring the airship to a dimension, you can fight the beast there. The more you unlock however, the better the outcome. The game doesn’t end with the beast and you will have to live with whichever dimension takes the damage. 

[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Discover the Dimensions
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/a60c58bcab2e436ccfe763899858ce3c1e02bf5e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Thena –[/b] Fantasy dimension that runs on basic and standard roll playing game logic. With the normal elves and humans using magic and other roll playing skills, Thena is the home of Doller, an apprentice Mage that just turned 24. With castles and fantasy tropes, Thena is full of side jobs, and lovable characters full of life.
[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/11d9d7fb97212a5e0622d7266e8d550cf5cab924.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Kanlin –[/b] A science fiction dimension that has been under serious attack by mysterious creatures that use magic against them. Not having any magical skills themselves, the residents of Kanlin instead use technology to fight back against the odds. It’s been two years since the Commander has shown up and helped to quell the invasion, but how much longer can they all hold out?

[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/048b5e2ba23a1d01259ddeca9b9ba8942964c78d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Jamonic –[/b] Stolen by a corrupt Earth corporation, the natives of Jamonic have been forced into slavery for as long as they can remember. None of them even know of the vast empire their ancestors left behind after invaded by Earth. Can Yeign really bring his dimension back to its former glory and expel the evil Shetman?
[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/f7b22b0cd06bdebd39d7a82317ee31f9f6609b78.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Cerabum –[/b] Literally based off the concept of Hell itself, the demons of Cerabum are what make up its landscape. Being underground, Cerabum has no night and day cycles, uses lava for light, and remains intensely hot all of the time. Without a reason for towns, Cerabum is a very hostile and unforgiving environment. Can the Dimensional Travelers stop Moria and her manipulative plans?   [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/19b3a28dcb62d216a6934fd5cd817a09ab9f7c4b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Rahmur –[/b] A mysterious dimension that only those that are able to unlock it can find the greatest path before them. Can you figure it all out and stop the beast without causing any harm? 

[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/5316b6cb86ecfc591ce8bb331f481cb22ee40a0b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Earth -[/b] The year is 2386 and the Shetman Corporation rose to power from out of nowhere. Using resources no one on Earth has any idea where the Shetman Corporation is getting them from, the citizens are oblivious their own lives are at stake. Can the Dimensional Travelers stop the beast's hunger and greed? Can they stop the heinous plans the CEO has in place? [/p]

notes.title: Meet the Villains
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/4aefcd39560db0b4657ba78b672bb800d66b5fd8.png[/img]

[b]Dimensional Beast –[/b] Only Dr. Nicolas Masio knows what the beast really is, but also knows there is only one real way to stop it as well. Destroying any dimension completely to nothing more than just the vacuum of space itself, the Dimensional Beast is a threat to unraveling the very fabric of the Universe and everything that holds it all together. Being misused as a tool of sorts, the beast is consuming more than it was ever supposed to. Can the Dimensional Travelers stop the Dimensional Beast before it’s too late?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/18622be2713ea8183e1676b49a262a91e95f17cb.png[/img]

[b]Demons of Cerabum –[/b] Coming from a dimension that was created from the concept of Hell itself, the demons are actively trying to help the destruction of the Universe just so they can claim they were a part of it all. The Grand Demon, Moria, is hiding a secret however from all of the demons in Cerabum that unlocks a hidden path the travelers never knew was there. Can Moria stop her own child from discovering the very secret of her origins?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/d4ef1fb5a5b6ba4659feab502c04f9080ff2e87f.png[/img]

[b]The Mystics –[/b] A group of fanatical lunatics that think the Dimensional Beast is their God coming back to take their souls. From the dimension of Kanlin, the Mystics work with the demons from Cerabum to open up magical dimensional gates to unlock the path to more destruction. Learning magic from the creatures being sent to their sci-fi world, the Mystics are a powerful group causing mass destruction everywhere they go. How deep have these fanatics actually buried themselves into the other dimensions as well as everything that’s going on? 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/4db07474815b53ecc71e9563bc58d4f699793428.png[/img]

[b]Shetman Corporation –[/b] A greedy Earth corporation that once discovering the dimensions, they immediately turn to slavery and genocide claiming it’s all for the better of mankind. Rising from a small company to Earth’s largest and most powerful corporation in just a few months, the CEO of the Shetman Corporation is willing to cut any corner it takes for profit margins. Not knowing the destruction they’re actually causing around them, will the Shetman Corporation end up destroying everything that is and ever was?

notes.title: Meet the Playable Characters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/04230259eee5af6ddc5bc772aabb0df54f32995c.png[/img]

[b]Doller –[/b] A lazy Apprentice Mage from Thena that would rather put things off until the last second. Taken from her world of magic and sent on an adventure that spans multiple dimensions, can Doller and her new friends actually save the Universe from the beast’s hunger and greed?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/dd71d39ad6d203030fdd0f4aac085c8d5a0d32ca.png[/img]

[b]Yeign –[/b] A Navish Warrior from Jamonic that has longed to become the leader of his people. With the Elder of Navon wanting his son Saine to take that position instead, Yeign has no idea the real reason his elder stands in his way. Can the Commander really bring the Dimensional Travelers together before anything bad happens to any one of them?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/4d55d65b683184f817faad1e7ca74033dca30e5d.png[/img]

[b]Yosei –[/b] A Pixie Thief that trusts no one, and for good reason, Yosei will come at anyone that calls him a fairy. Having no memory of where he came from, even the Commander has no idea what Yosei really is. Can you unravel the real truth behind this Pixie that’s lost his way?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/3ffcd736356c332a83995986c87a9dbe352940d1.png[/img]

[b]Freia –[/b] A well-mannered Demon from Cerabum that feels like a stranger everywhere she goes, even in her own dimension. Wanting to stop the destruction of the Universe, she has the opposite goals of all of her kind. Fighting who she was born to be, can Freia finally figure out why she feels so different to the rest?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/8b1d74c1d4da89c11838e6120c6d820a354f1e48.png[/img]

[b]Dr. Nicolas Masio –[/b] The Commander is an Earth scientist in the year 2386 that unknowingly finds dimensions hiding behind the strings in String Theory. Creating dimensional gates to be able to travel to and from these dimensions with ease, what Dr. Masio finds is beyond anything he could have ever imagined. Can he stop the destruction his own mind has unleased on the Universe?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/1c2306c7f391eed42de03e7f97b410e6f19bb914.png[/img]

[b]Symon –[/b] Machine Gun wielding leader of the Shadow Squad, Symon is driven by a code of ethics and is willing to help anyone in need that he can; even if it means bringing himself and his team in harm’s way. Able to Inspire his team to a fast victory, Symon is the heart and soul of the Shadow Squad.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/73fd1c7d7f6046e69034e48694344486f51538a0.png[/img]

[b]Syrah –[/b] Sword wielding general of the Shadow Squad, Syrah is more than confident and looks after her ‘boys’ well. Proud to call the Shadow Squad her team, Syrah will instill pride in anyone she leads, her Inspiration guides her ‘boys’ to honorable wins every single time.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/22c57e9c651cbba0d90db67f5b42cb9b7edb93dd.png[/img]

Snyde – Sword wielding hot headed member of the Shadow Squad that is ready for any engaging battle. Raging out and using serious sword technics, Snyde is not a force to be reckoned with. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/bb6a632a76ec5f871b37e51ade241e2dfbb44340.png[/img]

[b]Haze –[/b] Smart and calculated brains of the Shadow Squad. Using a Sniper Rifle, Tools, and Thrown Explosives, Haze is a formable opponent for any enemy. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/28b435707d3702edbeb790559fd4ba89c19a2afb.png[/img]

[b]Glenn –[/b] An Elf Ranger hermit that is oblivious to how Doller feels. Destined to help her defeat a terrible Lich that killed her parents, can Glenn still help her even though that same destiny has changed so much?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/d02767905978cb78e162568dce81ad0dcda6a026.png[/img]

[b]Saine –[/b] Rival to Yeign, Saine is a worthy warrior as well that finds himself on the same path to try and save their people from slavery. Losing everything he cares about as well, Saine becomes an ally to the only person he never thought he ever would. Can Saine help to bring back Feign, Yeign’s binding? 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/6d2ab5526d12544a750e9259b6b194015f93840b.png[/img]

[b]Jvar –[/b] A purple dog from Kanos that lost his dimension to the Dimensional Beast. With her trusty Red Ball and a ton of courage, can a simple dog really take on an entire corporation and save her master from wrongful imprisonment?
